eyebrow: The number that predicts real data loss
code:
SELECT db.name, drs.synchronization_health_desc,
       drs.log_send_queue_size, drs.redo_queue_size
FROM sys.dm_hadr_database_replica_states drs
JOIN sys.databases db ON drs.database_id = db.database_id;

-- growing log_send_queue_size = the secondary is
-- falling behind, right now, in real time
